verdict.rationale: Undermind is itself an AI research assistant. Inside the product, users can hand it an open-ended research goal; it asks clarifying follow-up questions, plans its own searches, and returns a ranked synthesis. Users can then brainstorm with an AI expert and generate custom tables. Community hands-on reports confirm delegated searches that return ranked, annotated results after follow-up questions. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the in-app assistant's scope and actions (current descriptions are short marketing lines), and evidence of delegation beyond literature search and synthesis tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Undermind asks follow-up questions to understand exactly what you need.
Brainstorm with an AI expert that has read the relevant literature. Generate custom tables to support your research.
Runs a deep literature review from an open-ended research goal and produces a ranked list of papers with a written synthesis. Plans its own searches, follows citations and key authors
returned 100 ranked, lightly annotated citations with topic-match scores
